root_cause: The V244 workflow always invoked candidate mode with --target V244. After V244 became stable, the compiler correctly rejected V244 as a candidate because its preregistered parent is V242 while the stable version was now V244. Active-mode validation was therefore unreachable.
correction: Create a new V245 architecture-only candidate with a two-mode workflow selected exclusively from the stable pointer: candidate mode when stable=V244, active mode when stable=V245. Candidate mode must retain full adversarial validation. Active mode must compile from the stable pointer with no --target, run the independent oracle, and assert the active ticket equals the preregistered ticket_id stored in the stable pointer.
